description.describe_ch: 民事訴訟法簡而言之即為民事案件於法院中尋求解決之程序規則。主要內容包括：訴訟主體、第一審程序、上訴審程序、抗告程序、再審程序、保全程序、公示催告程序等。
description.describe_eh: Civil Procedure are rules that guide a civil case through the court system. The content of this course including the following: standing, trial procedure, appeal procedure, objection proceeding, reexamination proceeding, securing proceeding and notice proceeding.
description.pre_subname: ELAW7013民法物權、ELAW7012民法債篇各論、ELAW7002民法債篇總論(二)
description.pre_sub_ename: ELAW7013 CIVIL CODE-PROPERTY、ELAW7012 CIVIL LAW: PARTICULAR KINDS OF OBLIGATIONS、ELAW7002 CIVIL LAW: GENERAL PRINCIPLES OF OBLIGATIONS(2)
